## Setup

```{r}
library(reticulate)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Load data in Python

```{python}
import pandas as pd

admissions_py = pd.read_csv("https://physionet.org/files/mimic-iv-demo/2.2/hosp/admissions.csv.gz")
admissions_py.head()
```

## Hand it to R and finish the analysis there

```{r}
admissions_r <- py$admissions_py

admissions_r <- admissions_r %>%
  mutate(los_days = as.numeric(
    as.POSIXct(dischtime) - as.POSIXct(admittime),
    units = "days"
  ))

admissions_r %>%
  select(hadm_id, admittime, dischtime, los_days) %>%
  head()
```

```{r}
admissions_r %>%
  summarize(
    avg_los = mean(los_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_los = max(los_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(admissions_r, aes(x = los_days)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, fill = "#B2182B") +
  labs(
    x = "Length of Stay (days)",
    y = "Number of Admissions",
    title = "Distribution of Length of Stay (data loaded in Python, analyzed in R)"
  )
```
